summary: KnitCount is the no-fuss row and stitch counter built for knitters and crocheters who can't afford to lose their place.
features: Screen stays awake while you work — no more waking your phone mid-row
Instant undo after a mis-tap — one tap corrects your last count
Multiple counters per project — track rows, pattern repeats, and increases all at once
Custom step sizes — count by 2s, 4s, or any number for complex patterns
Organize by project — switch between your sweater, socks, and blanket in seconds
